description: Use when the venue owner wants to undo a change made through update_products, add_products or hide_products. Pass the change_id returned when the change was saved. Undoing an added product hides it. Two steps: preview without confirm, then confirm: true after the owner agrees. Requires the owner to connect their PRENOTO account.

change_id.description: Returned by the tool that made the change.

confirm.description: false or omitted: preview only. true: undo, only after the owner agreed.

name: undo_change
title: Undo a change
